trigger.description: The pack's search could not use an index (search status IndexNotFound or IndexError), so context was assembled from a deterministic lexical scan of stored memories instead of ranked retrieval. Documented under bd-tjxvl, which measured it on a read-only pack with .ee/index and every index.previous.* moved aside.
setup_commands: ee remember 'Before release run the checklist.' --level procedural --kind rule --workspace .
# move .ee/index and every .ee/index.previous* out of the way

message_contains: Search index could not satisfy the context request
